pages.text: Altered from $(5)Fire Protection$(), $(4)Algid Resistor$() protects against freezing and lightning damage. Maximum level is $(4)IV$() and it conflicts with $(5)Protection$(), $(5)Fire Protection$(), $(5)Blast Protection$(), $(5)Projectile Protection$(), $(4)Corporeality$(), $(4)Atheism$() and $(4)Vigor$().

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: Algid Resistor is great when working in statically active environments, in stormy weather or freezing temperatures, since it works as active insulation. Otherwise, it's not particularly useful in mundane situations.
